model.name: Model for coagulation factors and readouts.

notes.body:
Model for coagulation factors and readouts.
The effects depend on the total concentration of apixaban in the venous plasma Cve_api, as the assays measure the total drug in a plasma sample: the anti-factor Xa activity is linear in the concentration, the INR, the prothrombin time (PT), the modified prothrombin time (mPT) and the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) follow an Emax model of the concentration relative to their baseline.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.
